description: Gesture-gated Tone.js bus graph, Howler sprite resolver, and preferences bridge for browser audio.
rules: Import browser runtime APIs from gesture-audio and Node-only asset verification APIs from gesture-audio/build-tools.
Call startOnGesture from a real user gesture and treat the supplied bootstrap callback as part of the retryable unlock transaction.
Use PreferencesBridge with an application-owned preference store; this package never owns persistence.
Keep generated docs/dist output out of source control and update the hand-authored docs with public API changes.
